rationale: The assistant correctly identified a blown E14 25W 300C oven lamp from the customer's reading of the old bulb, gave sensible isolate-and-cool advice, and escalated to an engineer only if a new bulb fails. Flaws: the first reply said any standard high-temperature bulb works without stressing the 300C rating check, and the second reply has a garbled step 1 and suggests up to 40W, which is unneeded and slightly risky. Overall the guidance is correct and useful.
